U: C1 [ U ] the fact that someone is legally responsible for something
（法律上對某事物的）責任，義務

S: C1 [ S ] something or someone that causes you a lot of trouble, often when that thing or person should be helping you

example: He denies any liability for the damage caused.
他對造成的損失拒絕承擔任何責任。
The business has liabilities of 2 million euros.
該公司負債達200萬歐元。
Compare
asset
After a certain age, a car's just a liability.
汽車在使用了一定年限後就會變成一個累贅。
Sue always manages to upset somebody when we go out - she's a real liability.
我們出去玩時，休總是讓人掃興——她真是個累贅。

after verb: C1 specialized law having (legal) responsibility for something or someone
承擔責任的；負有（法律）責任的
C2 very likely to do something
很可能會發生的，可能性很大的

example: The law holds parents liable if a child does not attend school.
法律規定孩子不上學父母要負責任。
If we lose the case we may be liable for (= have to pay) the costs of the whole trial.
如果我們輸掉了這場官司，就可能要承擔官司的全部費用。
The areas of town near the river are liable to flooding (= are often flooded).
這個城鎮靠近河邊的地區很容易遭到水淹。
[ + to infinitive ] He's liable to make a fuss if you wake him.
你如果把他吵醒了，他會大發雷霆的。

NONE: › to speak to people in other organizations, etc. in order to work with them or exchange information with them
› to be the link between two or more people, organizations, etc.

example: Our head office will liaise with the suppliers to ensure delivery.
我們總部會與供應商聯繫以保證交貨。
Her department liaises between the development team and the regional offices.
她的部門負責發展團隊與地區辦公室之間的聯絡。

S or U: › [ S or U ] communication between people or groups who work with each other
C: › [ C ] mainly US someone who helps groups to work effectively with each other
› [ C ] formal a sexual relationship, especially between two people not married to each other
（尤指婚外的）性關係；私通；婚外情

U: › [ U ] specialized phonetics the act of joining sounds together, for example pronouncing a consonant that is not usually pronounced at the end of a word, because the next word begins with a vowel sound

example: He blamed the lack of liaison between the various government departments.
他指責各個政府部門之間缺乏溝通。
The police have appointed a liaison officer to work with the local community.
警方已指派了一名聯絡官與當地社區進行合作。
She served as a liaison between the different groups.
她充當各團體之間的聯絡人。
He's had a number of liaisons.
他已發生了好幾段婚外情。

NONE: › a woody plant that grows in tropical forests

example: He's such a liar - you can't trust a word he says.
他是個大騙子——他說的話一句都不能信。
[ as form of address ] You liar - I never touched it!
你這個謊話連篇的傢夥——我從未動過它！
